entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please be aware that this call may be recorded for quality assurance. Your call will be connected to the next available agent.
I need to make a return.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. I can definitely help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309. Look, I just need a yes or no. Can I return this helmet?

Okay, I'm pulling up that order now. I see the TrailGuard helmet. I can certainly check on the return eligibility. First, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just a preference. The color online looked different. The box is still unopened, so I just want to send it back.
I understand completely. And just to confirm for our records, there are no defects or concerns about the helmet's safety features?
No, it's fine. It's brand new. I'm in a bit of a rush, can we just get this done?

Of course. One moment while I review the policy... Okay, I see the delivery was 34 days ago. Since this is a standard item, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.
Great. So you'll email me a label?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. You should receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method.
Okay, perfect. That's all I needed.
Glad I could help. Is there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
